channel.title: Page Studio · Selected work
channel.description: A one-person Northern Virginia design studio. Fixed-price, fixed-scope websites. New demos as they ship.

item.title: Six Coulees Land Trust
item.description: An invented land trust: a contour map that replays thirty-five years of protected parcels, with every figure summed live from one ledger.

item.title: Kettle & Sedge
item.description: An invented native landscape firm whose hero is a planting plan you can step from planting day to year three.

item.title: Halftone Hall
item.description: An invented 600-capacity music hall: a two-ink poster wordmark, a filterable show calendar with all-in prices, and accessible seating drawn as a floor plan.

item.title: Haskett & Mroz, CPAs & Advisors
item.description: An invented CPA firm with the tax year drawn as a ledger sheet that marks only the dates that apply to you, and published fee ranges.

item.title: Ninebrick
item.description: An invented wood-fired restaurant whose menu is set in the order one oven cooks it, with a live burn curve that rests on Mondays.

item.title: Aurelia Private Travel
item.description: A private-aviation membership sold in three patterns chosen by how you fly, not what you own. A variable-font wordmark that settles as you scroll, a parallax cloudscape, fine-line aircraft silhouettes drawn to scale, a transatlantic standing-pattern case study, and a live flight-time estimate. No stock photos, no exclamation points.
